about.headline: Software Engineering Rooted in Real Business Needs
about.bioP1: I am Daniel Gelchu, a solo software developer and systems engineer based in Ethiopia. I specialize in building fast, dependable web applications, digital catalogs, and business automation tools for local businesses and independent creators.
about.bioP2: Rather than relying on bloated page builders that crash on slow local mobile connections, I write clean, resilient code and configure zero-budget cloud architectures that run with 99.9% uptime and zero recurring dollar hosting bills.
about.bioP3: When you work with Biruh Digital, there are no project managers or agency markups—you collaborate directly with me. Every system is built to solve tangible operational problems and earn the trust of your clients.
principles: Strict mobile-first performance optimized for Ethiopian 3G/4G
Direct personal accountability on every project
Clean, documented code with no vendor lock-in
